labels.name: What is this session about?
labels.instruction: the whole session's subject and goal, never the current step alone: what is being built or changed, on what, and toward what outcome. Enough that someone who never saw this session can start working. No progress report.

labels.name: done
labels.instruction: what this round established or changed.

labels.name: next
labels.instruction: the required remaining work on this same task. Keep unrelated work out; name it only when it changes this result.

restrictions.name: unlinked_artifact
restrictions.message: names an MR or PR but gives no link to validate it

restrictions.name: required_labels
restrictions.message: runs {word_count} prose words, past the {maximum_words}-word confirmation, but omits the {missing_labels} label

restrictions.name: label_emphasis
restrictions.message: writes the {label}: label without bold emphasis

restrictions.name: label_separation
restrictions.message: runs the {label}: label into the line above it instead of starting its own block

restrictions.name: labeled_section_ceiling
restrictions.message: spends {word_count} words under the labeled blocks, past their {maximum_words}-word budget and its {grace_words}-word grace

restrictions.name: per_label_ceiling
restrictions.message: spends {word_count} words on the {label}: block, past its {maximum_words}-word budget and its {grace_words}-word grace

restrictions.name: unlabeled_body_ceiling
restrictions.message: spends {word_count} prose words above the labels, past their own {maximum_words}-word budget and its {grace_words}-word grace; move suitable detail into a short list, table, tree or diagram, which is not counted

restrictions.name: list_block_length
restrictions.message: stacks {line_count} list lines, past the {maximum_lines}-line ceiling for one list

restrictions.name: list_line_words
restrictions.message: runs a {word_count}-word list line, past the {maximum_words}-word ceiling and its {grace_words}-word grace for one line

restrictions.name: reaction_opener
restrictions.pattern: ^\s*(you're right|you are right|you're absolutely right|you are absolutely right|good catch|great question|great point|i apologize|my apologies|sorry|absolutely|sure thing|sure|of course|happy to)\b
restrictions.message: opens with a reaction or sycophancy phrase

restrictions.name: narration_opener
restrictions.pattern: ^\s*(let me\b|let's\b|i'll go ahead|i'll now|now i'll|now let me|first,? i\b|i'm going to|i am going to|i will now|i'm about to)
restrictions.message: opens by narrating what you are about to do

feedback.prefix: Reply breaks the enforced interactive rules
feedback.repair: Repair exactly that in the reply you already wrote, against the response shape section of the interactive communication instructions you are already carrying. Keep the answer and remove only filler. Loading a skill is not needed, because every enforced rule is already stated in those instructions.

instruction_paragraphs: A reply of {formats[confirmation][maximum_words]} prose words or fewer is a confirmation and takes no labels, a question included. Every longer reply ends with these labels, in order:

Optional visual first: a table, file tree, or diagram whenever it is the smallest useful form for the relationship, chosen through Humanize [representation selection](../SKILL.md#representation-selection). Visual lines never count against the budgets below.

Bold each label and leave a blank line between the blocks. Budgets are independent: the prose above the labels stays within {formats[labeled_reply][body][maximum_words]} words, the labels together within {formats[labeled_reply][combined_labels][maximum_words]}. Label budgets including grace: {label_budgets}. Body grace: {formats[labeled_reply][body][grace_words]}; confirmation: {formats[confirmation][grace_words]}; combined labels: {formats[labeled_reply][combined_labels][grace_words]} words.

One list stays within {lists[maximum_lines]} lines and {lists[item][maximum_words]} words per line, plus {lists[item][grace_words]} words of grace per item. Choose representations through Humanize first. Exclude visuals, fenced diffs, and lists of up to {lists[maximum_exempt_items]} items within the item budget plus grace from prose budgets. Other lists count as prose.
